description: A helper class that wraps Android's native Log utility to facilitate logging through a chain of LogNode objects; implements LogNode interface.

classes.name: LogWrapper
classes.description: A class that implements LogNode and wraps Android's Log utility to provide logging functionality with the ability to chain multiple LogNodes.

methods.name: getNext
methods.description: Returns the next LogNode in the chain.

methods.name: setNext
methods.description: Sets the next LogNode in the chain.

methods.name: println
methods.description: Logs the message using Android's Log and propagates the log to the next node if exists.
